project.description: Groww order adapter (live adapters plan step B3, 8 Nov 2026): Groww Trade API v1 create / modify / cancel with our tag as order_reference_id, the order list, per-order trades, positions, margins, Groww's instrument CSV; and a local Groww simulator with fault injection for DRY_RUN and tests. DRY_RUN only in this build: no LIVE connection exists. No SDK: plain HTTP (java.net.http) and Jackson.
